page: Microsoft Azure EC4ads_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the ECadsv6 server family. It is powered by an AMD processor with an x86_64 architecture and features 4 dedicated vCPUs. The server is configured with 32.0 GB of system memory, providing a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU. It runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor.

This instance includes 154 GB of local SSD storage and is premium storage capable, allowing for high-performance disk attachments. It does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses. There are no GPUs bundled with this configuration.

Given the 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, this server offers qualitative cost efficiency for memory-intensive workloads that do not require massive compute scaling. The combination of dedicated AMD vCPUs, a high memory allocation, and local SSD storage makes it suitable for relational databases, in-memory caching layers, and enterprise applications requiring a balanced, memory-heavy profile.
